'''Murkhana''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] on which the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]] was fought during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].

==Geography==
Murkhana was located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and was very close to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

Little was known about the planet's surface. However, it was known that Murkhana City, the capital, was built on the coastline with only a delimited stretch of black beachhead as the threshold into the steep hills the city was built on. The architecture was that of graceful, spiraling rising structures appearing reminiscent of ocean coral over sentient constructions.

It was the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] headquarters during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]].<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Anxious times for us, when Murkhana challenges our markets, and now Kem Stor Ai talks of war with Murkhana, which is too close for the hives' taste.|[[Sass Sikili]] to [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
In the [[pre-Republic era]], Murkhana was a member of [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] after the campaign to conquer the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]] between [[25,126 BBY|25,126]] and [[25,116 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Joining the Republic===
It was brought into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] only just prior to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A little over two months after then-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took up his post on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Murkhana was given a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]]. The move was viewed by some as a way for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to secure greater support in the Senate. Indeed, some senators, chief amongst them the then-delegate from [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], openly viewed Murkhana as a mere "client world" of the Trade Federation.<ref name="DP" />

===Clone Wars===
Murkhana served as the headquarters of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The tallest building in Murkhana was the [[Argente Tower/Legends|Argente Tower]], a complex of administrative offices. Murkhana was also the source for the many [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] "[[Shadowfeed/Legends|Shadowfeed Dispatches]]" which were used to distribute Separatist news and propaganda.<ref name="DL" />

During the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]], which occurred in the final days of the Clone Wars, the [[32nd Air Combat Wing]], led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Roan Shryne]] and [[Bol Chatak]], along with Chatak's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Olee Starstone]], were sent to destroy a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] protecting a key [[Murkhana Landing|landing platform]]. When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, it did not reach Murkhana until after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were over, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] outlawed, and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] created. When the order did arrive, the three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escaped execution thanks to [[Ion Team]], a unit of [[clone commando]]s led by Captain [[Climber (clone)|Climber]], whom Shryne had befriended during the course of the war. After word reached the ears of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that the troopers had disobeyed Order 66, Darth Vader was [[Mission to Murkhana (Great Jedi Purge)|dispatched]] to ensure that the clone troopers serving on the planet remained loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DL" />

===Second Galactic Civil War===
In the years leading to the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Murkhana was involved in a significant commercial dispute with the [[Roche asteroid field]]. The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] accused Murkhana of counterfeiting Verpine technology. [[Nav Ekhat]] was its [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] at this time. The planet [[Kem Stor Ai]] also considered going to war against Murkhana and the Verpine thought that Murkhana could use this conflict to attack Roche.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
